description: This file defines interfaces related to map (manifold absolute pressure) averaging in an engine management system firmware, including function prototypes for initialization, callback handling, and state refresh.

methods.name: mapAveragingAdcCallback
methods.description: Callback function to process new ADC sample values for map averaging.

methods.name: initMapAveraging
methods.description: Initializes map averaging with shared logger and engine context.

methods.name: refreshMapAveragingPreCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates values needed for map averaging, uses engine parameters.

methods.name: postMapState
methods.description: Outputs or updates the map state to TunerStudio channels.
